Disputing DRIFT-MULTIVERSE: FIXABLE by shrink plus shift-up inside a taller mask, no outpaint needed. The ORIGINAL saucer already runs off the frame (its stem/beam exits at y 719), and accepted redos C05-001/006/015 and C02 frames also have the hull or pod touching y 719. So a ship cut by the frame edge is normal framing, not a defect. What is wrong in the tries is size: comp_010_a1 disc 114 px vs old 93.6 = 1.22 (Z_10 1.25), and resc_010 sits 11 px low with a softened neighbour fragment. Concrete fix: scale the a1 ship to a disc of 85-90 px (0.91-0.96x of 93.6); centre at x ~682 (old saucer centre); raise the rim ~15-20 px to y ~665 so the spires land in clear sternum skin (y ~600-650 is clean); let the lower hull/pod run off the bottom edge like 001/006/015; extend the mask upward only, and exclude the tattoo fragments at x ~600 (left) and ~725-735 (right) so the inpaint never touches them; inpaint the old stem below the disc (y 700-719) to skin.
